title: A Bloch type space associated with λ-analytic functions
summary: For $λ\ge0$, the so-called $λ$-analytic functions are defined in terms of the (complex) Dunkl operators $D_{z}$ and $D_{\bar{z}}$. In the paper we introduce a Bloch type space on the disk ${\mathbb D}$ associated with $λ$-analytic functions, called the $λ$-Bloch space and denoted by ${\mathfrak{B}}_λ({\mathbb D})$. Various properties of the $λ$-Bloch space ${\mathfrak{B}}_λ({\mathbb D})$ are proved.
